section_summary: This section concerns visits by the Japanese ships Hakuho Maru and Hakuyo Maru to Alaska in 1933 and 1934. State, Navy, Commerce, Treasury, Interior, and Coast Guard officials weigh fur seal treaty cooperation and fisheries interests against concerns about access to strategically important Aleutian ports. It also records Hakuho Maru’s disputed visits to Attu and the arrangements for Hakuyo Maru’s training cruise.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Commander Lammers on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Navy intelligence discusses restricting Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian port access.
subfiles.summary: Lammers favors access only to ports with U.S. officials, excluding Kiska, citing strategy, reciprocity, and effects on island residents.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Ward T. Bower on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce argues against denying Hakuho Maru access to Aleutian ports.
subfiles.summary: Bower warns that refusal could damage Japanese cooperation under the fur seal treaty, imperil the seal skin industry, and prompt Japanese salmon fishing off Alaska. He identifies Unalaska as the only Aleutian location with American officials.

subfiles.title: Interdepartmental conversation on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce and Navy officials debate treaty cooperation and strategic access.
subfiles.summary: Bower sees restrictions as risking a breach of cooperation under the fur seal convention; Lammers disputes that interpretation. Ward seeks written departmental views.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on ship itineraries
subfiles.about: The Embassy gives Hakuho Maru’s possible port needs and Hakuyo Maru’s schedule.
subfiles.summary: Hakuho Maru expects to enter a port only for distress or water; Hakuyo Maru plans visits to Unalaska, St. Paul, and St. George.

subfiles.title: State Department transmittal to Navy
subfiles.about: State forwards the Japanese Embassy’s June 20 note and its own June 10 reply.
subfiles.summary: Transmits updated itineraries and earlier correspondence for Navy files.

subfiles.title: State Department transmittal to Treasury
subfiles.about: State forwards the Japanese Embassy’s revised ship itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Advises Treasury of Hakuho Maru’s possible emergency calls and Hakuyo Maru’s scheduled stops.

subfiles.title: State Department transmittal to Interior
subfiles.about: State forwards the Japanese Embassy’s revised ship itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Advises Interior of Hakuho Maru’s possible emergency calls and Hakuyo Maru’s scheduled stops.

subfiles.title: State Department transmittal to Commerce
subfiles.about: State forwards revised itineraries and its June 10 note to the Ambassador.
subfiles.summary: Supplies Commerce with the Japanese Embassy’s latest information and State’s earlier response.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard memorandum on Bering Sea patrol
subfiles.about: The Coast Guard lists patrol cutters and offers assistance during a Japanese vessel’s cruise.
subfiles.summary: Hamlet lists five cutters serving or passing through the Bering Sea, describes Coast Guard sealing enforcement experience, and offers to assign a cutter to accompany a Japanese vessel as a courtesy.

subfiles.title: Commerce letter on the Hakuho Maru visit
subfiles.about: Commerce urges accommodation of Japanese fur seal research and patrol activity.
subfiles.summary: Commerce argues that Japanese study of seal migration could be useful and consistent with treaty cooperation. It warns that refusal might lead Japan to abrogate the treaty, harming the recovered seal herd and U.S. fur processing. It also fears retaliatory Japanese salmon fishing near Alaska.

subfiles.title: Navy letter on Aleutian visits by Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Navy opposes unrestricted Japanese public vessel access to the Aleutians.
subfiles.summary: Navy regards the islands as strategically important and recommends visits only where U.S. officials are stationed, chiefly Unalaska. It finds no treaty duty to permit Japanese operations in U.S. territorial waters. If broader access is allowed, it proposes a Coast Guard escort.

subfiles.title: Confidential instruction to Tokyo
subfiles.about: State sends confidential correspondence on the proposed Japanese ship visits.
subfiles.summary: Lists and encloses six earlier notes, memoranda, and departmental letters.

subfiles.title: Governor Troy radiogram and Interior referral
subfiles.from: John W. Troy; Oscar L. Chapman
subfiles.to: Oscar L. Chapman; Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Alaska’s governor promises a friendly response to Hakuyo Maru’s cruise.
subfiles.summary: Troy requests practical aid from Coast Guard and Fisheries vessels; Interior forwards his message to State.

subfiles.title: Treasury authorization of courtesies to Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes its Juneau customs collector to assist Hakuho Maru.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities are authorized if the vessel calls for shelter or provisions.

subfiles.title: Pickens transmittal of Coast Guard dispatches
subfiles.about: Navy sends reports concerning Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian movements.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Bering Sea Patrol report and Coast Guard Headquarters’ reply.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard instructions to Bering Sea Patrol
subfiles.about: Headquarters answers a report on Hakuho Maru.
subfiles.summary: Directs the patrol to extend usual courtesies and make usual reports.

subfiles.title: Bering Sea Patrol report on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: The patrol reports Hakuho Maru’s arrival and visits to Attu.
subfiles.summary: Hakuho Maru anchored at Dutch Harbor after visiting Attu twice; its captain sought repairs and planned another Attu call.

subfiles.title: Confidential instruction forwarding Hakuho Maru correspondence
subfiles.about: State sends confidential copies concerning Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian visit.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Embassy note, two Coast Guard dispatches, and State’s July 5 note.

subfiles.title: Copy of Japanese Embassy itinerary note
subfiles.about: The Embassy gives Hakuho Maru’s port needs and Hakuyo Maru’s schedule.
subfiles.summary: Copies the June 20 note filed earlier on page 249.

subfiles.title: Copy of Bering Sea Patrol report
subfiles.about: The patrol reports Hakuho Maru’s Dutch Harbor arrival and Attu visits.
subfiles.summary: Copies the report filed earlier on page 267.

subfiles.title: Copy of Coast Guard instructions
subfiles.about: Headquarters instructs the patrol on Hakuho Maru.
subfiles.summary: Copies the direction to extend usual courtesies and make reports.

subfiles.title: Copy of State note protesting Attu visits
subfiles.about: State questions Hakuho Maru’s calls at Attu.
subfiles.summary: State says two Attu visits appeared unnecessary despite the vessel’s stated intention to call only for distress or water, and notes a planned third visit.

subfiles.title: Filed version of State note on Attu visits
subfiles.about: State questions Hakuho Maru’s calls at Attu.
subfiles.summary: Repeats State’s surprise at the two Attu visits and the captain’s stated plan to return.

subfiles.title: Commerce arrangements for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce arranges courtesies at the Pribilof Islands.
subfiles.summary: Fisheries officials instruct the Pribilof superintendent to receive Hakuyo Maru at St. Paul and St. George.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard report on Japanese fishing vessels
subfiles.about: The Coast Guard reports Japanese vessels in Bristol Bay and Hakuho Maru’s departure.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cannery ship and tender offshore, and Hakuho Maru returning toward Japan via Bowers Banks.

subfiles.title: Interior referral of radiogram
subfiles.about: Interior forwards information concerning courtesies to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: The underlying radiogram is largely illegible; Chapman forwards it in reply to State’s June 23 letter.

subfiles.title: Treasury notification of ship movements
subfiles.about: Treasury updates the Juneau customs collector on both Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Confirms notification of Hakuho Maru’s movements and Hakuyo Maru’s planned Alaskan stops.

subfiles.title: Miura’s explanation of Hakuho Maru’s Attu visits
subfiles.about: The Japanese Embassy explains Hakuho Maru’s Attu calls.
subfiles.summary: Miura attributes two outward calls to bad weather and a later call to water and engine repairs. Salisbury reiterates State’s stated position.

subfiles.title: Hornbeck letter forwarding Miura conversation
subfiles.about: State informs Navy of Japan’s explanation for the Attu visits.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the July 25 memorandum of conversation with Miura.

subfiles.title: Instruction to Tokyo forwarding Miura conversation
subfiles.about: State sends its account of Miura’s explanation.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the July 25 conversation memorandum for the Ambassador’s information.

subfiles.title: Pickens acknowledgment
subfiles.about: Navy acknowledges receipt of Miura’s explanation.
subfiles.summary: Pickens has referred the Attu memorandum to interested Navy offices.

subfiles.title: Treasury transmittal of Japanese letters
subfiles.about: Treasury forwards letters about Hakuyo Maru’s 1933 visit.
subfiles.summary: Encloses letters from Y. Sugiura and Consul Kiyoshi Uchiyama.

subfiles.title: Sugiura thanks Coast Guard commander
subfiles.about: The institute president thanks the Coast Guard for assisting Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Expresses gratitude for courtesies and facilities during the training vessel’s visit.

subfiles.title: Consul Uchiyama’s notice of Hakuyo Maru cruise
subfiles.about: The Japanese consul requests assistance for Hakuyo Maru’s training cruise.
subfiles.summary: Gives the ship’s personnel, purpose, and expected Dutch Harbor and St. Paul visits, requesting landing access, courtesies, and emergency protection.

subfiles.title: Telephone memorandum on 1934 Hakuyo Maru visits
subfiles.about: State checks Navy’s position on Hakuyo Maru’s proposed 1934 calls.
subfiles.summary: Commander Train confirms Navy has no objection to visits at Dutch Harbor and St. Paul, where U.S. officials are stationed. State plans to request a formal diplomatic application.

subfiles.title: Routing note on Hakuyo Maru request
subfiles.about: Requests routine handling of Hakuyo Maru’s proposed visit.
subfiles.summary: Directs Protocol to handle the request in the usual manner.

subfiles.title: Tokyo telegram requesting instructions
subfiles.about: Tokyo asks whether to issue documents for Hakuyo Maru’s 1934 cruise.
subfiles.summary: The institute seeks a crew list visa and bill of health for planned Dutch Harbor and St. Paul calls.

subfiles.title: State telegram requiring diplomatic request
subfiles.about: State directs the institute to seek permission through the Japanese Embassy.
subfiles.summary: Visa and health document instructions will follow receipt of a diplomatic request.

subfiles.title: State authorization of ship documents
subfiles.about: State authorizes documents for Hakuyo Maru’s 1934 calls.
subfiles.summary: Permits crew list visa and bill of health; students need no visas as through passengers.

subfiles.title: Visa Division memorandum on proposed authorization
subfiles.about: Visa Division reviews a draft authorization for Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Notes that Commerce’s reply is outstanding and suggests an informal check before sending the authorization. It also anticipates notices to Treasury and Labor.

subfiles.title: Protocol request for visa telegram
subfiles.about: Protocol requests a telegram authorizing Hakuyo Maru’s documents.
subfiles.summary: Notes Navy’s lack of objection and asks Visa Division to draft instructions for Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Handwritten note on Embassy reply
subfiles.about: A handwritten note directs a reply to the Japanese Embassy.
subfiles.summary: Requests that the Embassy be informed by informal memorandum of the usual procedure.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy memorandum on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: The Embassy asks how Hakuyo Maru may visit and land personnel.
subfiles.summary: Gives the captain, crew, students, planned Bristol Bay, Dutch Harbor, and St. Paul calls, and asks the required procedure.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Navy on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: State asks whether Navy objects to Hakuyo Maru’s proposed 1934 visits.
subfiles.summary: Describes the training cruise and asks Navy’s view if Japan submits a formal application for Dutch Harbor and St. Paul.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Commerce on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: State asks whether Commerce objects to Hakuyo Maru’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Describes the cruise, personnel, landing plans, and requested Dutch Harbor and St. Paul calls.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Interior on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: State asks whether Interior objects to Hakuyo Maru’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Describes the cruise, personnel, landing plans, and requested Dutch Harbor and St. Paul calls.

subfiles.title: Informal memorandum explaining port visit procedure
subfiles.about: State explains how to seek permission for Hakuyo Maru’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Requests a formal diplomatic note with vessel, ports, dates, and other details.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Hakuyo Maru’s visits
subfiles.about: Navy raises no objection to visits where U.S. officials are stationed.
subfiles.summary: Approves the proposed Dutch Harbor and St. Paul calls.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy formal request for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Japan formally requests approval of Hakuyo Maru’s cruise stops and landings.
subfiles.summary: Specifies Bristol Bay, Dutch Harbor, St. Paul, the captain, crew, students, and proposed dates.

subfiles.title: Protocol note on agency replies
subfiles.about: Protocol discusses waiting for agency views on a public vessel’s visit.
subfiles.summary: Advises awaiting responses from the interested departments, especially Navy and Commerce.

subfiles.title: Coordination and Review query
subfiles.about: A reviewer questions wording in the draft Embassy acknowledgment.
subfiles.summary: Questions promising another reply after agency responses arrive.

subfiles.title: State acknowledgment of Hakuyo Maru request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges Japan’s formal request for Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Recites the proposed itinerary and says State is consulting interested federal departments about usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: State request to Navy for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Navy has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State request to Treasury for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Treasury has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State request to Commerce for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Commerce has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State request to Interior for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Interior has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State request to Agriculture for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Agriculture has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State request to Labor for courtesies
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Hakuyo Maru if Labor has no objection.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the formal itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: State approval of Hakuyo Maru visits
subfiles.about: State approves Hakuyo Maru’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the visits are agreeable and usual courtesies have been arranged.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Hakuho Maru’s 1934 cruise
subfiles.about: Japan proposes Hakuho Maru calls at Attu and Atka during a fur seal cruise.
subfiles.summary: Lists Captain Eiichi Taketomi, crew, planned stops at Chichagof and Nazan, and possible weather shelter.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Commerce on Hakuho Maru’s 1934 cruise
subfiles.about: State relays Japan’s proposed Hakuho Maru cruise and port calls.
subfiles.summary: Describes the fur seal survey, captain, crew, Attu and Atka stops, and Japan’s request for approval; the letter continues beyond this section.
